scope: Intentional mobile hunter pressure change: physical sight or copied discrete shot origin; last-contact pursuit, bounded local search, return/hold. No new meshes, combat statistics or mission values.

design.sight: 360-degree physical LOS within 36m for hunters; not camera gaze. Guards retain their local rules.
design.hearing: 24m simple distance, through cover, once per consumed rifle round/shell; no acoustic simulation. No queued listening state.
design.fallback: Unreachable search candidates rejected by NPC grid/capsule and path; scan in place. Return timeout holds actual position, no teleport/despawn. Visible reacquisition works throughout.
design.pose: Face perceived path or committed attack target; stationary search yaw scan, existing Blender rigs and charge/hit priority.
design.restarts: Enemy IDs reset for deterministic search; state owned only by each run’s actors. Pause/planning stop updates/listening; no catchup.

raw.method: Exactly two ordinary terminal attempts through visible UI, one owned browser-timed driver, no source or hidden state inspected.
raw.verdict: Attractive and coherent prototype presentation, but these two runs did not deliver a readable, satisfying combat and navigation loop. Not AAA ready on this evidence.
merits: Rain, wet ground, teal lighting, signage and strong title typography establish a consistent drowned industrial setting.
Initial guard optic gave an understandable target; both runs earned one critical elimination.
Recovery visibly names Mara Solberg, changes objective, fills the first memory slot and restores supplies.
Facility map clearly labels archives, low cover, receiver reach, jammer and extraction; its pause instruction is explicit.
Space vault overcame a low obstacle in the second run and enabled memory recovery.
objections: Repeatedly ended facing a nearly featureless wall while the objective distance remained 15–18 m; the route cue said signal behind cover but did not make the required exit immediately clear to me.
Damage continued while I was trying to identify a route. Direction arrows indicated threats but I could not reliably locate and engage the damaging enemies in these captures.
Rifle and breacher volleys aimed toward a visible orange enemy did not yield an additional elimination; synthetic aiming and my misses limit conclusions about hit registration.
Dense small text and several simultaneous HUD messages compete for attention during fire.
Angular enemies and weapon forms look substantially more basic than the polished menu and lighting.

attempts.weaponUse: Coil rifle: 22-round initial volley killed induction guard; reload; 27-round volley toward archive enemy missed or failed to eliminate. No breacher use.
attempts.play: Flanked northwest, corrected east around archive wall, held E successfully, opened map, dashed northeast, reached wall near Heart and died during further east/north route attempt.

attempts.weaponUse: Coil rifle: eight initial rounds killed induction guard; reload; 18-round aimed volley did not eliminate archive enemy. Pump breacher selected, fired three shells without additional elimination. Final requested fire occurred after terminal loss.
attempts.play: Repeated northwest approach but stalled at low cover 16 m from receiver; attempted E too far away. Space vault then forward movement and E recovered Mara. Tried breacher and Shift, met north wall, turned east then north, remained near Heart wall, died during further strafe/dash attempt.

raw.method: Exactly two ordinary terminal attempts using only visible UI and the owned visible-playtest driver; default browser-timed input; default difficulty unchanged.
raw.verdict: A visually coherent, playable vertical slice with useful navigation and an understandable mission loop, but my two losses exposed substantial onboarding and combat legibility friction. Not AAA ready on the evidence I observed.
merits: Rain, wet ground reflections, teal lighting, architectural signage and restrained typography create a cohesive station atmosphere.
The paused facility map clearly labels archives, extraction and the Custodian. Held Tab provides a visible ground approach.
Memory recovery gives a clear named confirmation and restores supplies. The mission advances cleanly through three recoveries to the jammer.
Coil I visibly turned dark and the top readout changed to OFF after my second-attempt rifle volley; this made progress understandable.
objections: The handbook delivers many mechanics in a dense block before play; reading it did not translate into confident combat decisions under pressure.
I repeatedly walked into cover or overshot receiver rings. A distance of 3.3 to 4.0 metres still required another small step; the close prompt helped but recovery positioning remained fussy.
My first moving sentinel volley missed extensively, with only 4 rifle rounds remaining and no elimination. The breacher then emptied without an elimination while I pushed against cover.

At the boss, surrounding architecture repeatedly hid the target and I needed several turns to identify a clear coil face. Multiple small directional cues did not tell me which source caused each health loss.

In the second attempt health fell from 83 with 9 shield to terminal loss during the next reload/fire batch; I did not visibly identify the responsible attack before death. This is an observation of my visibility, not a claim about attack fairness or AI.

attempts.boss: Reached Custodian; last visible coil readout was all three at 100%; fired while approaching and died. No coil disable observed.
attempts.weapons: Rifle killed induction guard and heart warden; many rounds missed a moving sentinel and later scenery. Pump breacher fired through its magazine twice with no observed elimination, then reloaded; returned to rifle.
attempts.movement: Used map, Tab trace, strafing, jump/vault and Shift. Several failed receiver approaches and cover collisions retained in evidence.

attempts.boss: Reached Custodian, disabled coil I with rifle; last visible readout: I OFF, II 100%, III 100%. Died in next reload/fire batch.
attempts.weapons: Rifle only; induction critical elimination, reload before boss, successful coil volley, attempted reload and second volley.
attempts.movement: Applied first-attempt navigation learning, vaulted low cover, used two Shift attempts, and recovered all memories faster. Still needed small corrections at every receiver.
